question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

BREEZY
solution:
The correct answer is option 3

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the meaning of the word BREEZY and other options given in the options.
 
 
• **Breezy**:- pleasantly windy

 
 
• Example:- "it was a bright, breezy day"
 
 
 
• **Dusty**:- covered with, full of, or resembling dust. covered with, full of, or resembling dust.
 
 
• Example:- I am finding some dusty old records.
 
 
 
• **Airy**:- (of a room or building) spacious, well lit, and well ventilated 
 
 
• Example:- It was open and airy, bright and cheerful.
 
 
 
• **Noisy**:- making or given to making a lot of noise
 
 
• Example:- The area was crowded and noisy.
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence, according to the meaning of the words, the correct answer is **Airy.**
